title: Energy Transition: Conditions and the Grid
goal: I can state a condition about the power grid with *amennyiben …, úgy …*.
I can name the main terms of the energy transition (*karbontalanítás, energiamix, energiatárolás, rendszerirányító*).
I can explain why solar and wind power need storage.
